**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find the Law | |-------|------------|-----------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • 55 mph on rural interstates
• 65 mph on urban interstates (unless posted otherwise)
• 45 mph on rural highways, 35 mph on urban highways (unless posted)
• 25 mph in school zones during school hours | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.001–545.004 | | **Seat‑Belt & Child Restraint** | • All drivers and front‑seat passengers must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster.
• Children under 4 must be in a rear‑facing seat. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **DUI / Alcohol** | • Blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of 0.08 % or higher is illegal for drivers over 21.
• Zero‑tolerance (0.00 %) for drivers under 21.
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.021, 545.022 | | **Texting & Phone Use** | • Drivers may not text, email, or use a phone while driving unless hands‑free.
• Penalties: $50 fine, points on license. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **Headlights & Signal Use** | • Headlights must be on from sunset to sunrise, and during rain, fog, or low visibility.
• Turn signals must be used at least 100 ft before turning. | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.021, 545.022 | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • Yield to pedestrians in crosswalks.
• Stop at stop signs and red lights.
• At four‑way stops, the first vehicle to arrive has the right of way. | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.021, 545.022 | | **School Bus** | • Stop for a school bus with flashing red lights and a stop sign.
• Vehicles must stop on both sides of the road. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **Parking** | • No parking within 20 ft of a fire hydrant.
• No parking in a driveway or on a sidewalk unless permitted. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • All vehicles must be registered and display a valid license plate.
• Most vehicles must pass an annual safety inspection. | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.021, 545.022 | | **Towing & Tow‑away** | • Towing is allowed only after a 15‑minute waiting period if the vehicle is parked illegally.
• Towing of a vehicle that is not parked illegally is prohibited. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **Driving Under the Influence of Drugs** | • Penalties similar to DUI for alcohol. | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.021, 545.022 | | **Special Vehicle Rules** | • Motorcycles must have a helmet (unless under 18).
• Commercial vehicles must follow specific weight and size limits. | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.021, 545.022 | --- ### How to Find the Full Text 1. **Texas Transportation Code** – The primary source for all traffic laws. *Online:* https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/Docs/TRAN/htm/TRAN.545.htm 2. **Texas Department of Public Safety (DPS)** – Provides driver’s handbook, licensing information, and updates on law changes. *Website:* https://www.dps.texas.gov/ 3. **Texas Legislature Online** – For legislative history and amendments. *Website:* https://capitol.texas.gov/ 4. **Texas Courts** – For case law interpreting traffic statutes. *Website:* https://www.txcourts.gov/ --- ### Quick Tips for Safe Driving in Texas - **Always obey posted speed limits** – they can change at intersections or in construction zones. - **Use hands‑free devices** if you need to talk or listen to music while driving. - **Check your seat belt** before starting the engine. - **Keep a safe following distance** – at least 2 seconds behind the vehicle in front. - **Be extra cautious in school zones** – speeds are reduced and pedestrians are common. - **Stay alert for pedestrians and bicyclists** – especially in urban areas. --- #### Need More Specific Information? If you’re looking for details on a particular type of vehicle, a specific county’s regulations, or recent changes to Texas traffic law, let me know and I can dig deeper or point you to the exact statute or case law.
